summary: The filing reports an unregistered sale of 331,680 common shares for ~$8.49M in a continuous private offering under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D to accredited investors, and discloses NAV of $25.60/share as of March 31, 2026. This is a routine capital raise by a closed-end fund, not a special situation. No premium, tender, activist, restructuring, or strategic event is involved. The only financial data are the issuance terms and NAV.
